name: Amberley Vidya Putri
description: Amberley Vidya Putri (Sisi), a Computer Science student at Universitas Indonesia building web and mobile apps. Projects, experience and life off the clock.
tagline: Developer by practice, curious about pretty much everything. From tech to whatever rabbit hole i find myself in next!

about.paragraph: I’m a third-year Computer Science student at Universitas Indonesia who loves building things with code and figuring out how they work. Outside of tech, i try to find new things to get into. This semester’s side quest? Accounting.
about.away: I do it for the love of the game!
